g.text: Use only one correctly polarized source.

g.desc: Use only one correctly polarized source.

g.text: Fixed panel-voltage tracking; not dynamic MPPT.

g.desc: Fixed panel-voltage tracking; not dynamic MPPT.

g.text: ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - ERC/DRC do not replace bench verification. No lithium cell until dummy-load checks pass.

g.desc: ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - ERC/DRC do not replace bench verification. No lithium cell until dummy-load checks pass.

g.text: Attach 10k NTC, B=3380 K, to cell.

g.desc: Attach 10k NTC, B=3380 K, to cell.

g.text: R6 sets 500 mA maximum charge current.

g.desc: R6 sets 500 mA maximum charge current.

g.text: 1S protected Li-ion cell only; 4.20 V full charge.

g.desc: 1S protected Li-ion cell only; 4.20 V full charge.

g.text: Battery connector pin 1 = BAT+; pin 2 = GND.

g.desc: Battery connector pin 1 = BAT+; pin 2 = GND.

g.text: Timer retries if float not reached.

g.desc: Timer retries if float not reached.

g.text: Red only: bad-battery timeout. Both: NTC fault.

g.desc: Red only: bad-battery timeout. Both: NTC fault.

g.text: Both off: standby, no input, or low charging current.
